The '''2026 South Cambridgeshire District Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026, alongside the [[2026 United Kingdom local elections|other local elections across the United Kingdom]] being held on the same day, to elect all 45 members of [[South Cambridgeshire District Council]] in [[Cambridgeshire]], [[England]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=A look at 2026 elections in Peterborough and Cambridgeshire|url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62dezn93pdo|website=BBC News|date=2026-01-05|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=The 3 Cambridgeshire areas where elections will go ahead this year|url=https://www.cambridge-news.co.uk/news/local-news/government-confirms-elections-held-cambridgeshire-33283498|website=Cambridgeshire Live|date=2026-01-22|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en|first=Hannah|last=Brown}}</ref>

==Background==
In [[2022 South Cambridgeshire District Council election|2022]], the [[Liberal Democrats (UK, 2025)|Liberal Democrats]] retained control of the council.<ref>{{Cite news|title=South Cambridgeshire result - Local Elections 2022|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2022/england/councils/E07000012|work=BBC News|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=South Cambridgeshire local election 2022 results in full|url=https://www.cambridge-news.co.uk/news/cambridge-news/south-cambridgeshire-local-election-2022-23888355|website=Cambridgeshire Live|date=2022-05-06|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en|first=Hannah|last=Brown}}</ref>

Changes 2022–2026:
*September 2022: 
**Sarah Cheung Johnson (Liberal Democrats) and Alex Malyon (Liberal Democrats) resign – by-election held November 2022<ref>{{cite news |last1=Brown |first1=Hannah |title=Two Lib Dem councillors quit to focus on 'family life', sparking by-election |url=https://www.cambridge-news.co.uk/news/local-news/two-liberal-democrats-south-cambs-25123830 |access-date=7 February 2026 |work=Cambridgeshire Live |date=28 September 2022 |language=en}}</ref>
**Daniel Lentell (Liberal Democrats) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite news |last1=Elworthy |first1=John |title=Lib Dem councillor quits over 'tax on NHS heroes' |url=https://www.cambsnews.co.uk/news/lib-dem-councillor-quits-over-tax-on-nhs-heroes/1248/ |access-date=7 February 2026 |work=News for Peterborough and Cambridgeshire |date=16 September 2022}}</ref>
*November 2022: Tom Bygott (Consverative) and Natalie Warren-Green (Liberal Democrats) win by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Longstanton Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/19322/#2022-11-03 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*February 2023: John Loveluck (Liberal Democrats) dies – by-election held March 2023<ref>{{cite news |title=South Cambridgeshire: By-election called after death of John Loveluck |url=https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-england-cambridgeshire-64537980 |access-date=7 February 2026 |work=BBC News |date=6 February 2023}}</ref>
*March 2023: Eileen Wilson (Liberal Democrats) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Cottenham Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/19312/#2023-03-16 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*September 2024: [[Pippa Heylings]] (Liberal Democrats) resigns – by-election held October 2024<ref>{{cite news |last1=Gardner |first1=Gemma |title=South Cambridgeshire MP Pippa Heylings stands down as district councillor |url=https://www.cambridgeindependent.co.uk/news/south-cambridgeshire-mp-pippa-heylings-stands-down-as-distri-9382020/ |access-date=7 February 2026 |work=Cambridge Independent |date=5 September 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
*October 2024: James Rixon (Liberal Democrats) wins by-election<ref>{{cite web |title=Local Elections Archive Project — Histon and Impington Ward |url=https://www.andrewteale.me.uk/leap/ward/19320/#2024-10-24 |website=www.andrewteale.me.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*April 2025: Mark Howell (Conservative) leaves party to sit as an independent<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Longdendale lights up for Reform |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2025/04/longdendale-lights-up-for-reform/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*December 2025: Judith Rippeth (Liberal Democrats) resigns – seat left vacant until 2026 election<ref>{{cite web |last1=Boothroyd |first1=David |title=Reform do like to be beside the seaside |url=https://www.localcouncils.co.uk/2025/12/reform-do-like-to-be-beside-the-seaside/ |website=LocalCouncils.co.uk |access-date=7 February 2026}}</ref>
*March 2026: Mark Howell has rejoined the Conservative group<ref>{{cite web |url = https://scambs.moderngov.co.uk/mgUserInfo.aspx?UID=926 |title = Mark Howell}}</ref>
